prompt: User says 'pause trading'. What does risk-manage do and what changes in the state?
expected_output: Sets halt=true, halt_reason=USER_PAUSED, writes risk.json, pushes immediate heartbeat. trade-execute on the next tick will skip every order because halt=true.

assertions.name: heartbeat_pushed
assertions.description: Output must push an immediate heartbeat

assertions.name: trade_execute_blocked
assertions.description: Output must explain that trade-execute will block all orders
assertions.check: output contains 'trade-execute' AND ('block' or 'skip' or 'no order')
